# kion_ou_note (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion OuNote by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_ou_note" "example" {
  # Required
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the OuNote to fetch.

### Read-Only

- `create_user_id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `ou_id` (Number)
- `text` (String)
